name: World of Pannotia: Vanilla Loot Copies
summary: Internal module: unmodified copies of vanilla loot tables under the "vanilla" namespace so the pack minecraft: overrides can wrap them. It gives no gameplay changes.
editor_notes: 1404 loot tables. Compared with vanilla 26.1.2, the only differences are 26.2 vanilla additions (cinnabar and sulfur blocks, sulfur cube, a music disc added to the abandoned mineshaft chest); they are not pack changes. Not player-facing.
